scope: Root applies metadata only after checking each public API rationale; M2 and M5 remain deferred. Existing mechanical source fixtures are preserved and missing real examples supplemented.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: No defaultValue contract; supplying it is rejected.

OtpInput.reason: Public native checked or ControllableValueProps mode permits a real default* fixture; Field validation is delegated through native/composite field context.

inapplicableIndependentStates.readOnly: ChoiceBaseProps explicitly omits readOnly and runtime sanitizes it.

SegmentedControl.reason: value/onValueChange is required; component asserts controlled-only mode; native/project-level disabled and composite Field validity are real.

inapplicableIndependentStates.readOnly: No readOnly public prop or root behavior.
inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: No defaultValue and runtime controlledOnly assertion.

Slider.reason: Public native checked or ControllableValueProps mode permits a real default* fixture; Field validation is delegated through native/composite field context.

ColorPicker.reason: Public native checked or ControllableValueProps mode permits a real default* fixture; Field validation is delegated through native/composite field context.

TagInput.reason: Public native checked or ControllableValueProps mode permits a real default* fixture; Field validation is delegated through native/composite field context.

Form.reason: busy supplies actual loading semantics; error/validation fixtures compose actual Field/Input errors and form aria-invalid. Long content is a visible form instruction.

inapplicableIndependentStates.empty: Form has no data-empty mode; an empty descendant input is that child's value state.

Field.reason: Owns labels, messages and invalid-field association. Direct error is both error feedback and validation; long labels/hints are visible.

inapplicableIndependentStates.empty: Field owns label/message association, not its child's input value; no independent empty contract.

FileUpload.reason: Mandatory items/onFiles makes the caller own queue updates. Uploading/error item statuses are actual public data contracts; items=[] is an empty queue; Field supplies validation context.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: No defaultItems/defaultValue queue contract. Native file chooser internal state is not an uncontrolled queue.

MarkdownEditor.reason: Public value/onValueChange is required; implementation checks controlled-only mode. Real textarea readOnly/disabled/aria-invalid states and long source content are demonstrated.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: defaultValue is omitted and runtime rejects uncontrolled value mode.

RichTextEditor.reason: Public value/onValueChange is required; implementation checks controlled-only mode. Real textarea readOnly/disabled/aria-invalid states and long source content are demonstrated.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: defaultValue is omitted and runtime rejects uncontrolled value mode.

CodeEditor.reason: Public value/onValueChange is required; implementation checks controlled-only mode. Real textarea readOnly/disabled/aria-invalid states and long source content are demonstrated.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: defaultValue is omitted and runtime rejects uncontrolled value mode.

InlineEdit.reason: Persisted value/onCommit is controlled-only. New fixtures exercise awaited save delay, actual rejected commit, empty value, validate and long committed name.

inapplicableIndependentStates.readOnly: No readOnly public prop; async saving temporarily locks draft internally.
inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: Internal draft is not an uncontrolled persisted value; value/onCommit are required.

Select.reason: Implementation asserts controlled-only selection. loading is explicit; empty options and disabled options/root are real; validation comes from Field.

inapplicableIndependentStates.error: No independent remote-load error prop; a parent Field validation is separately demonstrated.

SearchableSelect.reason: Delegates to controlled-only Combobox; no loading prop. Empty options, disabled root and Field validation are real.

inapplicableIndependentStates.uncontrolled: No defaultValue; delegated Combobox asserts controlled-only.
inapplicableIndependentStates.loading: No loading prop; use AsyncSelect for remote loading.

AsyncSelect.reason: ControllableValueProps/Query plus explicit loading/error/onRetry and options/loadOptions contracts support actual states; retry fixture updates failed -> ready.

Combobox.reason: Selection asserts controlled-only value mode; disabled and Field validity are real, with long options and actual setters.

Autocomplete.reason: ControllableValueProps/Query supports defaultValue; explicit loading exists. Field validation and long option text are rendered.

MultiSelect.reason: Actual ControllableListValueProps/ValueProps supports value and defaultValue. Disabled data/root and composite Field validity are implemented; long options are visible.

Cascader.reason: Actual ControllableListValueProps/ValueProps supports value and defaultValue. Disabled data/root and composite Field validity are implemented; long options are visible.

TreeSelect.reason: Actual ControllableListValueProps/ValueProps supports value and defaultValue. Disabled data/root and composite Field validity are implemented; long options are visible.

Transfer.reason: ControllableListValueProps supports both value and defaultValue, even though the old shared profile omitted uncontrolled. Composite Field validity and long option labels are real.

DateField.reason: Native DateFieldValueProps has controlled and defaultValue branches; native readOnly/disabled/aria-invalid and visible Field long label are real.

DateRangeField.reason: ControllableValueProps and explicit disabled/readOnly/invalid/rangeError support actual date-range states.

TimezoneSelect.reason: ControllableValueProps plus disabled and Field context provides real defaultValue/validation behavior; long content is an associated visible label.

DEFAULT_TIMEZONE_OPTIONS.reason: Nonvisual constant data, demonstrated by passing it to actual TimezoneSelect options.

DragDrop.reason: Only add actual disabled and long-content demonstrations. Existing keyboard fixture remains the official DragDrop+FileUpload composition; no M5 capability expansion or closure.
